title: Desktop Workflow and Assets
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of training.py, retrain.py, testing.py, and GUI boundaries, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in face-recognition-attendance-system.
learning_objectives: Explain training.py, retrain.py, testing.py, and GUI boundaries in plain language and connect it to AMS_Run.py; index.html; WORKFLOW.md.
Trace one input through the desktop workflow and assets stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: training.py, retrain.py, testing.py, and GUI boundaries
practical_outcomes: Trace the desktop workflow and assets stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for training.py, retrain.py, testing.py, and GUI boundaries.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
